item.title: Using a Linux Laptop as a Hotspot for a PS5
item.description: It was Thanksgiving week, and with Black Friday happening, I finally decided to get a PS5. I didn’t expect it to feel like such a big moment, but walking out of Best Buy with the box in hand was surprisingly exciting—almost like driving off with a new car. I even buckled it into the passenger seat on the way home. Once I got back, though, I ran into a small issue.
